007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.agent;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.SelectAIAgent;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.agent.Tool;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.EmailNotificationToolParams;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolAttributes;
015import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolStatus;
016import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.agent.ToolType;
017
018/**
019 * Creates a persistent email notification tool using typed {@link EmailNotificationToolParams}.
020 *
021 * <p>Set {@code SELECTAI_DB_USER}, {@code SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD},
022 * {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}, {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME}, and
023 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_CREDENTIAL_NAME},
024 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_RECIPIENT},
025 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_SENDER},
026 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_SMTP_HOST}.
027 * The named database credential and SMTP configuration must already be usable by the connected database user.</p>
028 *
029 * <p>Optionally set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_SUBJECT}.</p>
030 * <p>Optionally set {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INSTRUCTION} and
031 * {@code SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_DESCRIPTION}. This sample creates a tool but
032 * does not run it or invoke its external service. Closing the client does not
033 * drop the tool. Run {@link DropToolSample} with the same tool name and database
034 * connection settings to remove it. Use a new tool name to avoid replacing
035 * an existing resource.</p>
036 *
037 * @see ToolParamsSample
038 */
039public final class CreateEmailNotificationToolSample {
040
041    private CreateEmailNotificationToolSample() {
042    }
043
044    /**
045     * Creates the configured tool without executing it.
046     *
047     * @param args unused command-line arguments
048     * @throws SelectAIException when an SDK operation fails; the process exits unsuccessfully
049     */
050    public static void main(String[] args) throws SelectAIException {
051        String toolName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_NAME");
052        EmailNotificationToolParams params = EmailNotificationToolParams.builder()
053                .credentialName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_CREDENTIAL_NAME"))
054                .recipient(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_RECIPIENT"))
055                .sender(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_SENDER"))
056                .smtpHost(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_SMTP_HOST"))
057                .subject(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_SUBJECT"))
058                .build();
059        ToolAttributes attributes = ToolAttributes.builder()
060                .toolType(ToolType.NOTIFICATION)
061                .toolParams(params)
062                .instruction(env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_INSTRUCTION"))
063                .build();
064
065        try (SelectAIAgent client = createClient()) {
066            Tool tool = client.tool(toolName, attributes,
067                    env("SELECTAI_AGENT_TOOL_DESCRIPTION"), ToolStatus.ENABLED);
068            System.out.printf("Create tool '%s' completed: %s%n", toolName, tool.create());
069        }
070    }
071
072    private static SelectAIAgent createClient() throws SelectAIException {
073        return SelectAIAgent.create(DbConnectionConfig.builder()
074                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
075                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
076                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
077                .build());
078    }
079
080    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
081        String value = env(name);
082        if (value == null) {
083            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
084        }
085        return value;
086    }
087
088    private static String env(String name) {
089        String value = System.getenv(name);
090        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? null : value;
091    }
092}
